purpose: Five moves graded by how much of the file survived the move.

windows.head: c1
windows.note: all five are moves by authorship; what differs is whether the two blobs support the claim

pairs.note: light edit: a reviewer sees the same file
most blocks touched, but the lines are still there
moved and rewritten: a header and one block survive
nothing survives but the shared header

notes: The two evidence=none pairs are the point of the fixture. They are true, so they belong in recall; they are also indistinguishable from an unrelated new file by anyone holding only the two blobs, so a detector that reports them at a fact-grade confidence will report the scaffold twin in scaffold_decoys just as confidently. The recommendation section prices that.
Every moved file was deleted from its old path in the same commit, so all five pairs are visible to every window policy.
